data.heading: How we work with clients
data.subheading: Clear scope, clear pricing, no surprises.

items.question: Do you work on fixed prices?
items.answer: Yes. Every project starts with a fixed-scope proposal. Changes are quoted before we begin them.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: A typical marketing site is live in six to eight weeks from kick-off.

items.question: Who owns the work?
items.answer: You do. All design files, code and content are yours once the final invoice is paid.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
items.answer: Monthly care plans cover updates, security, hosting and a set number of change requests.

items.question: Can you work with our in-house team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We often join existing teams as design or front-end partners.
